ambiguity: GLOSS.cone gap: on a grid, is a creature in the Cone when any part of its square is, or only when the centre of its square is?
ruling: A creature is in the Cone when the centre of its space (its position) lies inside the Cone, so the 15-ft width at 15 ft covers exactly three squares.
note: A centre exactly on the edge is inside. Revisit when creature spaces (T-46) give Large creatures several squares.
